purpose: Distinguish preparation/background evolution from load-timed AP response within one protocol; not a new model fit or policy validation.
selection: Fixed symmetric order before new outcomes. Each condition occurs twice at mean ordinal 3.5. This removes a linear ordinal term from condition mean contrasts algebraically, not arbitrary wall-time drift, carryover or causal confounding.
data_role: Prospective structure-discrimination data plus unchanged-candidate conditional evaluation. No coefficient fitting, no new-model independent confirmation. If later used for development, retain that role and require separate unseen confirmation.
model: ap-preparation-memory-v1; beta/original relative slopes, tau30, gamma0 unchanged
initialization: All conditions use only AP read brackets wholly after baseline start and before common+35s. At least55s/15samples, gaps<=10s; same E/H initializer, anchor last pre-cutoff AP. No later AP input, including L65's extra wait.
comparison: common-origin queries >=35s until actual cooling end; >=20 valid targets, gaps/end coverage<=10s. Post-work curves also use actual last lane release; control has no fabricated last lane or work start.
contrasts: For each fully bracketed fixed common window report both per-condition repeats and arithmetic mean differences L35-C/L65-C/L65-L35. Null if any required arm or endpoint is absent; no interpolation over >10s gaps, no imputation, no causal claim. No measured control/AP/current fed into load predictions.
readout: absolute AP and change from fixed anchor
signed residual and MAE/max/peak difference on the same per-session samples
fixed common and last-lane-relative window changes
actual lane occupancy and request denominator
full120s observed device J as a separate conditional-unit measure
prediction: Offline reconstruction with actual lane schedule and pre-cutoff AP; not online/end-to-end arrival prediction
sensor_limits: AP query brackets approximately2-3s in archives, quantized0.1C values; not certified hardware refresh, uncertainty, per-request power or physical internal temperature
environment: Reuse installed APK, resident/runtime4/warmup8, input bytes, screen/thermal/quality gates and polling. No ambient value invented. Session-to-session passive90s does not prove thermal reset.
stop: First original execution/environment/quality/budget failure or AP input/coverage failure stops entire plan; no retry/replacement/addition/refit. Preserve original and subsequent recovery errors. A poor but eligible prediction is recorded and does not stop remaining fixed contrasts.
completion: All six eligible arms plus fixed metrics/contrasts, or bounded partial failure. If background/load response remains indistinguishable, report unidentified and stop; do not add sessions or search models automatically.
